appraisal_events.evidence: en entendant son coup de sonnette je me sentais délivré de mes préoccupations
appraisal_events.explanation: As a staged participant, the narrator moves from anxious distress to felt relief the moment Saint-Loup arrives, a direct emotional consequence of the interaction rather than mere retrospective commentary.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator gains emotional relief and steadiness as a direct staged effect of Saint-Loup's arrival, distinct from (though related to) Saint-Loup's own local elevation already captured in the accepted annotation.

ambiguities: The narrator's relief upon Saint-Loup's arrival could be read as merely the flip side of Saint-Loup's already-captured elevation rather than an independent status change; scored conservatively here as a distinct but modest emotional-position gain for the narrator, per the consummation/renewal principle that dependency-based relief should not be read as diminishment.

La grand-mère is mentioned only as an object of the narrator's passing worry ('l'envie de revoir ma grand'mère ou par la peur qu'elle ne fût souffrante') with no staged interaction or local evaluative movement of her own in this passage, so she was not scored.
